meta.note: Derived from credit-sectors. Where an RBI press release printed a year-ago figure for the month (December 2022 on), growth is the published amount over RBI's own printed year-ago amount, so it matches the release; earlier months compare with the same month a year before. The headline is bank credit of all scheduled commercial banks (Section 42). From December 2025 RBI compares month-end figures with the last reporting Friday a year earlier. July 2023 to June 2024 includes the HDFC merger's one-time jump; see credit-scb-ratios for growth excluding it.

meta.note: RBI, Deployment of Bank Credit by Major Sectors, old format (DBIE export via the Data Bank), ₹ lakh crore, last reporting Friday of each month. Bank credit, food credit and non-food credit cover all scheduled commercial banks (Section 42 return); every sector and industry row covers the selected banks of the sector-wise and industry-wise return (SIBC), about 90% of non-food credit from September 2017. Priority sector follows the definition before April 2015. A ₹17,300 crore drop in consumer durables in August 2018 corrects one bank's misclassified housing loans. Never joined to the 2019 format. Bank, food and non-food credit are the Section 42 figures of the same reporting date (DBIE reports 689 and 1130) wherever those reports carry it; on 2019-12-20, 2020-12-18 the export printed a different fortnight's figures.

RBI, Deployment of Bank Credit by Major Sectors, new format, ₹ lakh crore: the DBIE export to 2026-07-31, then the monthly press-release workbooks. Bank credit, food credit and non-food credit cover all scheduled commercial banks (Section 42 return); every sector and industry row covers the selected banks of the sector-wise and industry-wise return (SIBC), about 95% of non-food credit. Each month is its last reporting fortnight; from December 2025 the last day of the month (Banking Laws (Amendment) Act 2025). From July 2023 the figures include HDFC Ltd's loans, merged into HDFC Bank: housing loans jump and loans to NBFCs drop that month. Since May 2024 one bank reclassifies a category of agricultural loans as loans against gold jewellery. Not merger-adjusted. Bank, food and non-food credit are the Section 42 figures of the same reporting date (DBIE reports 689 and 1130) wherever those reports carry it; on 2019-12-20, 2020-12-18, 2021-06-18, 2022-05-20, 2022-06-17, 2023-05-19, 2023-10-20, 2023-11-17, 2024-03-22, 2024-10-18, 2025-02-21, 2025-03-21, 2025-04-18 the export printed a different fortnight's figures.
